name: Mixed JA/EN — conditional approval with approval gate
transcript:
[00:00:08] Nakamura: Good morning. Thank you for presenting the proposal today.
[00:00:14] Alex: Good morning Nakamura-san. We are very excited about this opportunity.
[00:00:20] Nakamura: 提案内容については前向きに検討しています。ただし、いくつかの条件があります。
[00:00:30] Alex: Of course. Please share your conditions.
[00:00:36] Nakamura: まず、価格を10%引き下げていただく必要があります。また、実装スケジュールを6週間短縮できますか。
[00:00:48] Alex: The 10% reduction is something we can discuss. The timeline compression will be challenging but we can explore it. Can I ask — if we meet these conditions, do we have your approval?
[00:01:00] Nakamura: 条件を満たしていただければ、我々としては進める意向があります。ただし、最終的な承認は稟議が必要です。購買委員会の承認を得てから正式にお伝えします。
[00:01:15] Alex: Understood. When does the purchasing committee meet?
[00:01:20] Nakamura: 来週の水曜日です。それまでに修正提案をいただけますか。
[00:01:27] Alex: Absolutely. We will send a revised proposal with the adjusted pricing by Monday.

summary: Nakamura expressed conditional interest, requiring a 10% price reduction and timeline compression.
Final approval requires ringi process through the purchasing committee meeting next Wednesday.
Alex will send a revised proposal with adjusted pricing by Monday.

action_items.task: Send revised proposal with adjusted pricing
